title: Provably Efficient Q-learning for Robust Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: 用于鲁棒强化学习的可证明高效Q学习

paragraphs.en: Standard reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms based on Markov Decision Processes (MDPs) are vulnerable to sim-to-real gaps. To address this issue, distributionally robust RL algorithms based on robust MDPs (RMDPs) have been proposed, for ensuring that agents can perform reliably to unpredictable conditions in real-world environments. Despite of the rich literature, an efficient model-free method is still lacking for robust RL, particularly for Markovian data, which is more relevant in practical applications. In this work, we take a step towards settling this problem by proposing a sample efficient (asynchronous Q-learning) algorithm for robust RL. In particular, consider a γ \gamma -discounted infinite-horizon RMDP with state space 𝒮 \mathcal{S} and action space 𝒜 \mathcal{A} , where the uncertainty set is specified by the total variation (TV) distance with uncertainty level σ \sigma . paragraphs.en: As a fast-growing subfield of artificial intelligence, reinforcement learning (RL) demonstrated impressive success across various domains, including networked systems ( Qu et al., 2022 ) , trading ( Park and Van Roy, 2015 ) , operations research ( de Castro Silva et al., 2003 ; Pan et al., 2023 ; Zhao et al., 2021 ) , large language model alignment ( Ziegler et al., 2019 ) , healthcare ( Fatemi et al., 2021 ; Liu et al., 2019 ) , and robotics and control ( Kober et al., 2013 ; Mnih, 2013 ) . Due to the unprecedented dimensionality of the state-action space, enhancing sample, space and computational efficiency has become a central challenge in contemporary RL applications. As a result, significant research efforts have been devoted to developing sample-efficient and memory-efficient algorithms and to characterizing the sample complexity and space complexity ( Li et al., 2021b ; Li et al., 2024c ; Li et al., 2022 ) across diverse RL settings, including different algorithm paradigms (model-based ( Li et al., 2024c ) ; model-free ( Li et al., 2021a ; Zhang et al., 2021 ) ) and different data-access regimes (online ( Zhang et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2020 ) ; offline ( Li et al., 2024b ; Rashidinejad et al., 2022 ) ).
paragraphs.zh: 作为人工智能领域中一个快速发展的分支，强化学习（RL）在多个领域取得了令人瞩目的成功，包括网络化系统（Qu et al., 2022）、交易（Park and Van Roy, 2015）、运筹学（de Castro Silva et al., 2003；Pan et al., 2023；Zhao et al., 2021）、大语言模型对齐（Ziegler et al., 2019）、医疗健康（Fatemi et al., 2021；Liu et al., 2019）以及机器人与控制（Kober et al., 2013；Mnih, 2013）。 由于状态-动作空间具有前所未有的维度，提升样本效率、空间效率和计算效率已成为当代强化学习应用中的核心挑战。 因此，大量研究工作致力于开发样本高效且内存高效的算法，并在多样的强化学习设定下刻画样本复杂度和空间复杂度（Li et al., 2021b；Li et al., 2024c；Li et al., 2022），这些设定涵盖不同的算法范式（基于模型的（Li et al., 2024c）；无模型的（Li et al., 2021a；Zhang et al., 2021））以及不同的数据访问模式（在线（Zhang et al., 2024；Li et al., 2020）；离线（Li et al., 2024b；Rashidinejad et al., 2022））。

paragraphs.en: Despite this progress, practical applications of standard RL techniques can still be greatly affected by the sim-to-real gap or environmental uncertainty ( Bertsimas et al., 2019 ; Zhang et al., 2020 ) . For instance, a standard RL agent trained in an ideal environment might fail dramatically when the real-world environment is subject to small adversarial disruptions ( Klopp et al., 2017 ; Mahmood et al., 2018 ) . Consequently, in addition to maximizing the expected total reward, robustness has emerged as an important goal for an RL agent, especially in high-stakes applications like robotics, autonomous driving, clinical trials, and financial investments. To address these challenges, distributionally robust RL ( Bäuerle and Glauner, 2022 ; Cai et al., 2016 ; Iyengar, 2005 ; Nilim and El Ghaoui, 2005 ; Xu and Mannor, 2010 ; Shi et al., 2025 ; Shi et al., 2024b ; Jiao and Li, 2024 ) , offers a flexible framework by drawing on principles from distributionally robust optimization and supervised learning ( Bertsimas et al., 2018 ; Blanchet and Murthy, 2019 ; Chen et al., 2019 ; Duchi and Namkoong, 2021 ; Gao, 2023 ; Lam, 2019 ; Rahimian and Mehrotra, 2019 ) . This approach aims to develop policies capable of maintaining high performance even when the deployed environment deviates from the nominal model due to environmental uncertainty.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管取得了这些进展，标准强化学习技术的实际应用仍可能受到模拟到现实的差距或环境不确定性的严重影响（Bertsimas et al., 2019；Zhang et al., 2020）。 例如，在理想环境中训练的标准强化学习智能体，当现实环境受到微小的对抗性扰动时，可能会出现严重的失败（Klopp et al., 2017；Mahmood et al., 2018）。 因此，除了最大化期望总回报之外，鲁棒性已成为强化学习智能体的一个重要目标，尤其是在机器人、自动驾驶、临床试验和金融投资等高风险应用中。 为了应对这些挑战，分布鲁棒强化学习（Bäuerle and Glauner, 2022；Cai et al., 2016；Iyengar, 2005；Nilim and El Ghaoui, 2005；Xu and Mannor, 2010；Shi et al., 2025；Shi et al., 2024b；Jiao and Li, 2024）借鉴分布鲁棒优化和监督学习的原理，提供了一个灵活的框架（Bertsimas et al., 2018；Blanchet and Murthy, 2019；Chen et al., 2019；Duchi and Namkoong, 2021；Gao, 2023；Lam, 2019；Rahimian and Mehrotra, 2019）。 这种方法旨在开发出即使部署环境因环境不确定性而偏离名义模型时仍能保持高性能的策略。

paragraphs.en: Existing approaches address this problem with different resource requirements. Model-based methods estimate and store the nominal transition kernel and then perform robust planning, requiring O ⁡ ( S 2 ​ A ) O(S^{2}A) space ( Shi et al., 2024a ; Zhou et al., 2021 ; Panaganti and Kalathil, 2022 ; Yang et al., 2022 ) . The model-free method in Wang et al. (2024) reduces the space requirement to O ⁡ ( S ​ A ) O(SA) , but relies on generative-model access to query arbitrary state-action pairs. Such access is not assumed in our trajectory setting. For Markovian data, Yang et al. (2023) use stochastic gradient ascent to update a dual variable in a penalized Bellman formulation alongside the Q-function. Their reported Q-function convergence rate for the χ 2 \chi^{2} -divergence formulation is O ( t − 1 / 3 ) O(t^{-1/3}) , which is significantly slower compared with the O ( t − 1 / 2 ) O(t^{-1/2}) rate of standard Q-learning. These limitations motivate the following question:

sents.en: These limitations motivate the following question:
sents.zh: 这些局限性引出了以下问题：

paragraphs.en: Can a model-free algorithm for RMDPs learn from a single trajectory with O ⁡ ( S ​ A ) O(SA) space complexity and a sample complexity comparable to that of standard Q-learning?
paragraphs.zh: 无模型算法能否在 O ⁡ ( S ​ A ) O(SA) 空间复杂度下，从单条轨迹中学习，并达到与标准 Q-learning 相当的样本复杂度？

paragraphs.en: To answer this question, we address two challenges: constructing surrogate state with worst-case expected value from nominal trajectory data without estimating the transition kernel, and controlling the resulting estimation error when the worst-case kernel changes across stages. Our approach uses resampling rather than the dual optimization of Yang et al. (2023) . Compared with the standard Q-learning analysis of Li et al. (2024a) , our analysis needs to additionally account for resampling bias and error propagation under changing worst-case kernels. We summarize these contributions in Section 1.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 为回答这一问题，我们应对两个挑战：在不估计转移核的情况下，从标称轨迹数据构建具有最坏情况期望值的替代状态；以及在最坏情况核随阶段变化时，控制由此产生的估计误差。 我们的方法采用重采样，而非 Yang et al. (2023) 的对偶优化。 与 Li et al. (2024a) 的标准 Q 学习分析相比，我们的分析还需要额外考虑重采样偏差以及最坏情况核变化下的误差传播。 我们在第 1.2 节中总结这些贡献。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we propose an efficient Q-learning algorithm for RMDPs that integrates several key advantages. Specifically, the algorithm achieves the optimal space complexity of O ⁡ ( S ​ A ) O(SA) , and operates effectively in the asynchronous setting in terms of sample complexity. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first algorithm that combines all these advantages and is supported by a rigorous theoretical analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了一种用于RMDP的高效Q学习算法，该算法集成了若干关键优势。 具体而言，该算法达到了 O ⁡ ( S ​ A ) O(SA) 的最优空间复杂度，并且在异步设定下在样本复杂度方面也能有效运行。 据我们所知，这是第一个同时结合所有这些优势并有严格理论分析支持的算法。

sents.en: In this paper, we propose an efficient Q-learning algorithm for RMDPs that integrates several key advantages.

sents.en: To the best of our knowledge, this is the first algorithm that combines all these advantages and is supported by a rigorous theoretical analysis.

paragraphs.en: In particular, assume that we have access to a single trajectory of the Markov decision processes (MDPs) with a transition nominal kernel induced by a stationary behavior policy (also called an asynchronous setting). Consider an uncertainty set with the shape and size of the ball specified by the total variation (TV) distance between probability distributions and some uncertainty level σ ∈ ( 0 , 1 ) \sigma\in(0,1) . Let S S be the size of the state space, A A the size of the action space, γ \gamma the discount factor. We are interested in how the space complexity and the sample complexity — the number of samples required for an algorithm to output a Q-function whose entrywise error with the optimal Q-function is at most ε \varepsilon — scales with all these salient problem parameters. Our main contributions are as follows.
paragraphs.zh: 特别地，假设我们可以访问由平稳行为策略（也称为异步设置）诱导的转移标称核的马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）的单条轨迹。 考虑一个不确定性集合，其球的形状和大小由概率分布之间的总变差（TV）距离和某个不确定性水平 σ ∈ ( 0 , 1 ) \sigma\in(0,1) 来指定。 设 S S 为状态空间的大小，A A 为动作空间的大小，γ \gamma 为折扣因子。 我们关注的是空间复杂度和样本复杂度——即算法输出一个其与最优Q函数的逐元素误差至多为 ε \varepsilon 的Q函数所需的样本数量——如何随所有这些关键问题参数进行扩展。 我们的主要贡献如下。

paragraphs.en: We design an efficient Q-learning algorithm for RMDPs that operates on a single trajectory and achieves O ⁡ ( S ​ A ) O(SA) space complexity. At each time step, the agent selects an action according to a behavior policy and observes the next state s t + 1 ∼ P 0 ( ⋅ | s t , a t ) s_{t+1}\sim P^{0}(\cdot|s_{t},a_{t}) according to the nominal transition kernel. We observe that the worst-case transition kernel can be realized by thresholding the value function of s t + 1 s_{t+1} and redirecting state samples with large values to a fixed state. This allows us to construct a surrogate state s t + 1 ′ s_{t+1}^{\prime} and update the Q-function following the same form as ( 2 ), but with the value function from an earlier stage to avoid using the current Q-estimate when constructing s t + 1 ′ s_{t+1}^{\prime} . The resulting space complexity is O ⁡ ( S ​ A ) O(SA) , which is optimal in the tabular setting where Q-values are explicitly stored. Moreover, the algorithm processes samples as they arrive along a single trajectory generated by a fixed behavior policy. It does not require a generative model or the ability to query arbitrary state-action pairs.
paragraphs.zh: 我们为 RMDP 设计了一种高效的 Q-learning 算法，该算法在单条轨迹上运行，并实现 O(SA) 的空间复杂度。 在每个时间步，智能体根据行为策略选择一个动作，并按照标称转移核观测下一状态 s_{t+1}∼P^{0}(·|s_{t},a_{t})。 我们观察到，最坏情况下的转移核可以通过对 s_{t+1} 的值函数设置阈值，并将具有较大值的状态样本重定向到一个固定状态来实现。 这使我们能够构造一个替代状态 s'_{t+1}，并按照与 (2) 相同的形式更新 Q 函数，但使用较早阶段的值函数，以避免在构造 s'_{t+1} 时使用当前的 Q 估计值。 由此得到的空间复杂度为 O(SA)，在显式存储 Q 值的表格型设定下这是最优的。 此外，该算法在由固定行为策略生成的单条轨迹上，对到达的样本进行即时处理。 它不需要生成式模型，也不需要查询任意状态-动作对的能力。

paragraphs.en: Robust MDPs have been extensively studied, both empirically and theoretically, under various forms of uncertainty sets ( Panaganti and Kalathil, 2021 ; Ding et al., 2024 ; Goyal and Grand-Clement, 2023 ; Ho et al., 2018 ; Ho et al., 2021 ; Iyengar, 2005 ; Xu and Mannor, 2010 ; Tamar et al., 2014 ) . However, most existing theoretical studies either focus on planning algorithms ( Tamar et al., 2014 ; Xu and Mannor, 2010 ; Iyengar, 2005 ) or adopt an asymptotic perspective ( Roy et al., 2017 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 鲁棒马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）已在各种形式的不确定集下得到了广泛的研究，包括实证研究和理论研究（ Panaganti and Kalathil, 2021 ; Ding et al., 2024 ; Goyal and Grand-Clement, 2023 ; Ho et al., 2018 ; Ho et al., 2021 ; Iyengar, 2005 ; Xu and Mannor, 2010 ; Tamar et al., 2014 ）。 然而，大多数现有的理论研究要么专注于规划算法（ Tamar et al., 2014 ; Xu and Mannor, 2010 ; Iyengar, 2005 ），要么采用渐近的视角（ Roy et al., 2017 ）。

paragraphs.en: Recently, several robust RL algorithms have been developed, focusing on finite-sample performance guarantees under various sampling mechanisms, as show in Table 1 . A line of work focuses on model-based algorithms. In particular, Yang et al. (2022) ; Panaganti and Kalathil (2022) studied model-based robust RL algorithms with an ( s , a ) (s,a) -rectangular uncertainty set specified by the TV distance, which matches our uncertainty-set specification, and used data collected from a generative model, corresponding to the synchronous setting in this work. They also considered other uncertainty sets, including those specified by the χ 2 \chi^{2} -divergence or the KL divergence, and Yang et al. (2022) additionally considered the s s -rectangular case under these measures. Zhou et al. (2021) assumed that the reward follows a certain distribution on a bounded set and conducted an offline analysis where states are uniformly sampled by a known policy, focusing on uncertainty sets defined by the KL divergence. Panaganti and Kalathil (2021) proposed a policy iteration algorithm based on linear function approximation and analyzed its convergence asymptotically under certain dedicated assumptions on the iterative policy and the induced stationary distribution. Though an asynchronous setting is considered, its space complexity in the tabular case is O ⁡ ( S 2 ​ A 2 ) O(S^{2}A^{2}) to store the feature matrix. Moreover, Shi et al. (2024a) provided the near-optimal sample complexity bounds for model-based robust RL algorithms with access to a generative model when the uncertainty set is measured by the TV distance or the χ 2 \chi^{2} -divergence. Specifically, for a TV-based uncertainty set, the minimax-optimal sample complexity of O ~ ​ ( S ​ A ε 2 ​ ( 1 − γ ) 2 ​ max ⁡ { 1 − γ , σ } ) \widetilde{O}\left(\frac{SA}{\varepsilon^{2}(1-\gamma)^{2}\max\{1-\gamma,\sigma\}}\right) is achieved by robust value iteration. However, these algorithms require at least O ⁡ ( S 2 ​ A ) O(S^{2}A) space complexity to store the transition probability kernel, which is prohibitive for large-scale problems.
paragraphs.zh: 近年来，已有若干鲁棒强化学习算法被提出，其重点在于各种采样机制下的有限样本性能保证，如表 1 所示。 有一个研究方向专注于基于模型的算法。 特别地，Yang 等人 （2022）；Panaganti 与 Kalathil（2022）研究了基于模型的鲁棒强化学习算法，其采用由 TV 距离刻画的 ( s , a ) (s,a)-矩形不确定性集合，这与本文的不确定性集合设定一致，并且使用了从生成模型收集的数据，对应于本文的同步设定。 他们还考虑了其他不确定性集合，包括由 χ 2 \chi^{2} 散度或 KL 散度刻画的不确定性集合，Yang 等人 （2022）还在这些度量下额外考虑了 s s-矩形的情形。Zhou 等人 （2021）假设奖励服从有界集合上的某种分布，并在状态由已知策略均匀采样的设定下进行了离线分析，聚焦于由 KL 散度定义的不确定性集合。 Panaganti 与 Kalathil（2021）提出了一种基于线性函数逼近的策略迭代算法，并在对迭代策略及其诱导的平稳分布的某些专门假设下，对其收敛性进行了渐近分析。 尽管考虑了异步设定，但在表格情形下其存储特征矩阵的空间复杂度为 O ⁡ ( S 2 ​ A 2 ) O(S^{2}A^{2})。此外，Shi 等人 （2024a）针对可访问生成模型的基于模型的鲁棒强化学习算法，在不确定性集合由 TV 距离或 χ 2 \chi^{2} 散度度量时，给出了近最优的样本复杂度界。 具体而言，对于基于 TV 的不确定性集合，鲁棒值迭代达到了 O ~ ​ ( S ​ A ε 2 ​ ( 1 − γ ) 2 ​ max ⁡ { 1 − γ , σ } ) \widetilde{O}\left(\frac{SA}{\varepsilon^{2}(1-\gamma)^{2}\max\{1-\gamma,\sigma\}}\right) 的极小极大最优样本复杂度。 然而，这些算法至少需要 O ⁡ ( S 2 ​ A ) O(S^{2}A) 的空间复杂度来存储转移概率核，这对大规模问题而言是不可承受的。

paragraphs.en: Another line of research focuses on memory-efficient algorithms with a reduced space complexity of O ⁡ ( S ​ A ) O(SA) and their finite-sample performance analysis. Wang et al. (2023) ; Wang et al. (2024) considered a randomized reward function and an ( s , a ) (s,a) -rectangular uncertainty set under the KL divergence with a sufficiently small uncertainty level σ ≲ p min \sigma\lesssim p_{\min} , where p min p_{\min} denotes the minimum nominal transition probability. They reduced the space complexity by collecting a large batch of samples and using them to update the Q-function for one state-action pair ( s , a ) (s,a) at a time, then discarding the data before moving on to the next one. This design achieves O ⁡ ( S ​ A ) O(SA) space complexity; however, it implicitly assumes that the learner can query any state-action pair on demand, an assumption that holds under a generative model (synchronous setting) but fails in the asynchronous setting, where samples arrive sequentially along a single trajectory induced by the behavior policy. In addition, the restriction σ ≲ p min \sigma\lesssim p_{\min} on the uncertainty level limits its applicability. In contrast, Yang et al. (2023) proposed an algorithm for the asynchronous setting that performs Q-learning-style stochastic approximation updates on the penalized dual formulation of the RMDP. Their analysis relies on two key assumptions: that the Markov chain induced by the behavior policy is uniformly ergodic, which is also assumed in our work, and that the objective in the Bellman operator is strongly convex at its optimum. Under these conditions, they derived sample complexity bounds for various uncertainty sets, with an explicit bound of O ~ ​ ( 1 μ 𝗆𝗂𝗇 9 ​ ε 3 ​ ( 1 − γ ) 9 ​ ( 1 ( 1 − γ ) 6 + t 𝗆𝗂𝗑 3 ) ) \widetilde{O}\left(\frac{1}{\mu_{\mathsf{min}}^{9}\varepsilon^{3}(1-\gamma)^{9}}\left(\frac{1}{(1-\gamma)^{6}}+t_{\mathsf{mix}}^{3}\right)\right) for the χ 2 \chi^{2} -divergence. This bound has worse dependence on the accuracy and mixing parameters than ours, although the two results concern different uncertainty sets.
paragraphs.zh: 另一条研究路线聚焦于空间复杂度降为 O ⁡ ( S A ) O(SA) 的节省内存的算法及其有限样本性能分析。Wang et al. (2023)；Wang et al. (2024) 研究了随机化奖励函数以及 KL 散度下不确定性水平足够小（σ ≲ p min \sigma\lesssim p_{\min}）的 ( s , a ) (s,a)-矩形不确定性集，其中 p min p_{\min} 表示最小名义转移概率。 他们通过收集一大批样本并用其一次只更新一个状态-动作对 ( s , a ) (s,a) 的 Q 函数，然后在处理下一个状态-动作对之前丢弃数据，从而降低了空间复杂度。 这种设计实现了 O ⁡ ( S A ) O(SA) 的空间复杂度；然而，它隐含地假设学习者可以按需查询任意状态-动作对，这一假设在生成模型（同步设定）下成立，但在异步设定下不成立，因为样本沿由行为策略诱导的单条轨迹依次到达。 此外，对不确定性水平的限制 σ ≲ p min \sigma\lesssim p_{\min} 也限制了其适用范围。相比之下，Yang et al. (2023) 提出了一种适用于异步设定的算法，该算法对 RMDP 的带惩罚对偶形式执行 Q-learning 式的随机逼近更新。 他们的分析依赖两个关键假设：一是行为策略诱导的马尔可夫链一致遍历（这也是我们工作中采用的假设），二是 Bellman 算子中的目标函数在其最优点处强凸。 在这些条件下，他们针对各种不确定性集导出了样本复杂度界，其中针对 χ 2 \chi^{2}-散度的显式界为 O ~ ​ ( 1 μ 𝗆𝗂𝗇 9 ​ ε 3 ​ ( 1 − γ ) 9 ​ ( 1 ( 1 − γ ) 6 + t 𝗆𝗂𝗑 3 ) ) \widetilde{O}\left(\frac{1}{\mu_{\mathsf{min}}^{9}\varepsilon^{3}(1-\gamma)^{9}}\left(\frac{1}{(1-\gamma)^{6}}+t_{\mathsf{mix}}^{3}\right)\right)。 该界对精度和混合参数的依赖性比我们的结果更差，尽管这两个结果针对的是不同的不确定性集。

paragraphs.en: The remainder of this paper is organized as follows. Section 2 provides an overview of discounted infinite-horizon standard MDPs and formulates the RMDP problem. Section 3 proposes an asynchronous Q-learning algorithm for robust RL, with its sample complexity presented in Section 4 . Section 5 outlines the main steps of the theoretical analysis. Finally, we conclude the paper in Section 6 with further discussions. Detailed proofs are included in the appendix.

paragraphs.en: In this section, we formulate robust Markov decision processes (RMDPs) within the infinite-horizon setting and present two sampling mechanisms.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们在无限时域设定下构建鲁棒马尔可夫决策过程（RMDP）的公式，并给出两种采样机制。

paragraphs.en: We first introduce the standard framework of MDPs to facilitate understanding of RMDPs. A discounted infinite-horizon MDP is represented by a quintuple ℳ = { 𝒮 , 𝒜 , γ , P , r } \mathcal{M}=\{\mathcal{S},\mathcal{A},\gamma,P,r\} , where 𝒮 = { 1 , ⋯ , S } \mathcal{S}=\{1,\cdots,S\} and 𝒜 = { 1 , ⋯ , A } \mathcal{A}=\{1,\cdots,A\} are the state and action spaces, respectively. The parameter γ ∈ [ 0 , 1 ) \gamma\in[0,1) represents the discount factor, P : 𝒮 × 𝒜 → Δ ⁡ ( 𝒮 ) P:\mathcal{S}\times\mathcal{A}\rightarrow\Delta(\mathcal{S}) represents the probability transition kernel, and r : 𝒮 × 𝒜 → [ 0 , 1 ] r:\mathcal{S}\times\mathcal{A}\rightarrow[0,1] stands for the reward function, which is assumed to be deterministic and known.

paragraphs.en: Intuitively, for each ( s , a ) ∈ 𝒮 × 𝒜 (s,a)\in\mathcal{S}\times\mathcal{A} , the TV-based uncertainty set ( 5 ) allows a total probability mass of at most σ \sigma to be redistributed among next states relative to the nominal distribution. paragraphs.en: Our algorithm differs from that of Yang et al. (2023) in the Bellman formulation, the update mechanism, and the scope of uncertainty sets. First, our Bellman operator minimizes the expected next-state value over an uncertainty set, whereas theirs penalizes the divergence from the nominal transition kernel. They show that, for a given initial-state distribution, a suitable penalty coefficient yields the same optimal objective value as the constrained formulation. The two formulations nevertheless lead to different update mechanisms. Second, their method uses stochastic gradient ascent to update the dual variable alongside Q-function updates. These dual-variable updates slow the overall convergence because the dual variable must converge faster than the Q-function to control the overall error. In the generative-model setting, this requirement is reflected in an additional inner optimization loop. Our method instead approximates the robust Bellman update using a single resampled next state and online estimates of the resampling parameters. This avoids dual optimization and achieves a smaller sample complexity bound (Table 1 ). Third, their framework accommodates general divergences under regularity conditions, whereas our resampling scheme is tailored to TV-based uncertainty sets. Table 1 compares their χ 2 \chi^{2} -divergence formulation with our TV-based formulation. We use their χ 2 \chi^{2} -divergence result because their paper explicitly provides a convergence rate for this case, but not for the others.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的算法与 Yang 等人的算法不同。 （2023）在 Bellman 公式、更新机制以及不确定性集合的范围上均存在差异。 首先，我们的 Bellman 算子在不确定性集合上最小化期望的下一状态价值，而他们的方法惩罚与标称转移核的偏差。 他们证明，对于给定的初始状态分布，合适的惩罚系数可以得到与约束形式相同的最优目标值。 尽管如此，这两种形式会导致不同的更新机制。 其次，他们的方法使用随机梯度上升在更新 Q 函数的同时更新对偶变量。 这些对偶变量的更新会拖慢整体收敛速度，因为对偶变量必须比 Q 函数收敛得更快才能控制整体误差。 在生成模型设定下，这一要求体现为一个额外的内层优化循环。 我们的方法则使用单个重采样的下一状态以及重采样参数的在线估计来近似鲁棒 Bellman 更新。 这避免了对偶优化，并取得了更小的样本复杂度界（表 1）。 第三，他们的框架在正则性条件下可容纳一般的散度，而我们的重采样方案是针对基于 TV 的不确定性集合量身定制的。 表 1 比较了他们的 χ 2 \chi^{2} 散度形式与我们的基于 TV 的形式。 我们使用他们的 χ 2 \chi^{2} 散度结果，因为他们的论文明确给出了这一情形的收敛速率，而其他情形则没有。

Specifically, the algorithm maintains an estimate of the Q-function Q t Q_{t} , value function estimates V k V_{k} for the three most recent stages, threshold estimates [ τ k , s , a 𝖫 ] ( s , a ) ∈ 𝒮 × 𝒜 [\tau_{k,s,a}^{\mathsf{L}}]_{(s,a)\in\mathcal{S}\times\mathcal{A}} and [ τ k , s , a 𝖱 ] ( s , a ) ∈ 𝒮 × 𝒜 [\tau_{k,s,a}^{\mathsf{R}}]_{(s,a)\in\mathcal{S}\times\mathcal{A}} , and probability estimates [ p k , s , a ] ( s , a ) ∈ 𝒮 × 𝒜 [p_{k,s,a}]_{(s,a)\in\mathcal{S}\times\mathcal{A}} for the current and the last stages. The total space complexity is thus in the order of S ​ A SA . In comparison, although the previous model-based algorithms achieve smaller sample complexity, they suffer a significantly larger space complexity of O ⁡ ( S 2 ​ A ) O(S^{2}A) due to the need to store and process transition probability matrices.

paragraphs.en: Compared with the standard Q-learning analysis of Li et al. (2024a) , our analysis addresses two additional challenges. First, errors in the estimated resampling parameters cause the distribution of the surrogate state s t + 1 ′ s_{t+1}^{\prime} to deviate from the target worst-case kernel P V k − 2 P^{V_{k-2}} . This introduces resampling bias into the Bellman update, which we isolate in ( 50 ) and bound in Lemma 5 . Second, the worst-case kernel depends on the value function and changes across stages. The resulting error propagation requires bounds on accumulated variance terms under these changing kernels, developed in Lemmas 7 – 9 .
paragraphs.zh: 与 Li 等人（2024a）的标准 Q-learning 分析相比， 我们的分析还面临两个额外的挑战。 首先，重采样参数估计中的误差会导致替代状态 s_{t+1}^{\prime} 的分布偏离目标最坏情况核 P^{V_{k-2}}。 这会在 Bellman 更新中引入重采样偏差，我们在式（50）中将其分离出来，并在引理 5 中给出界。 其次，最坏情况核依赖于值函数，并随阶段变化。 由此产生的误差传播需要对这些变化核下累积方差项的界，我们在引理 7–9 中给出推导。

paragraphs.en: We are now positioned to describe how to establish Theorem 1 . Lemma 1 establishes the correctness of the ideal resampling construction. Lemmas 2 and 3 then control the expectation and variance errors introduced by its approximate implementation. Building on these guarantees, we establish convergence in four steps. Step 1 decomposes the Q-function estimation error into propagated estimation error, resampling bias, and sampling noise. Step 2 uses Lemmas 2 and 3 to control the resampling bias and the sampling noise within a single stage. Step 3 bounds the cumulative sampling noise under changing worst-case kernels. Step 4 combines these bounds to establish the sample complexity guarantee.
paragraphs.zh: 我们现在可以描述如何建立定理 1。 引理 1 确立了理想重抽样构造的正确性。 引理 2 和引理 3 随后控制其近似实现所带来的期望误差与方差误差。 在这些保证的基础上，我们分四步建立收敛性。 第 1 步将 Q 函数估计误差分解为传播的估计误差、重抽样偏差和抽样噪声。 第 2 步利用引理 2 和引理 3 控制单个阶段内的重抽样偏差和抽样噪声。 第 3 步在最坏情形核变化的条件下对累积抽样噪声进行界定。 第 4 步综合这些界以建立样本复杂度保证。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we present a model-free algorithm designed for RMDPs, and provide a sharp analysis for its sample complexity under uncertainty sets defined by the Total Variation (TV) distance, assuming access of a single sample trajectory. Our algorithm achieves an optimal space complexity of O ⁡ ( S ​ A ) O(SA) , which is significantly more efficient compared to the O ⁡ ( S 2 ​ A ) O(S^{2}A) space requirement of existing model-based approaches. Compared with other memory-efficient algorithms, our algorithm operates in a more realistic asynchronous setting. Furthermore, we demonstrate that the algorithm reliably produces an ε \varepsilon -approximate Q-function estimate using O ~ ​ ( 1 μ 𝗆𝗂𝗇 ​ ε 2 ​ ( 1 − γ ) 3 ​ max ⁡ { 1 − γ , σ } + t 𝗆𝗂𝗑 μ 𝗆𝗂𝗇 ​ ( 1 − γ ) ) \widetilde{O}\left(\frac{1}{\mu_{\mathsf{min}}\varepsilon^{2}(1-\gamma)^{3}\max\{1-\gamma,\sigma\}}+\frac{t_{\mathsf{mix}}}{\mu_{\mathsf{min}}(1-\gamma)}\right) samples. This bound is nearly minimax optimal with an additional factor of O ~ ​ ( 1 1 − γ ) \tilde{O}\left(\frac{1}{1-\gamma}\right) , and significantly outperforms sample complexity of existing asynchronous Q-learning algorithms for RMDPs. Finally, we extend both the algorithm and its analysis to the synchronous setting, achieving a sample complexity of O ~ ​ ( S ​ A ε 2 ​ ( 1 − γ ) 3 ​ max ⁡ { 1 − γ , σ } ) \widetilde{O}\left(\frac{SA}{\varepsilon^{2}(1-\gamma)^{3}\max\{1-\gamma,\sigma\}}\right) . These results highlight the effectiveness and efficiency of our model-free method in addressing RMDPs.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了一种专为 RMDP 设计的无模型算法，并在可获取单条样本轨迹的假设下，对由全变差（TV）距离定义的不确定集给出了其样本复杂度的精确分析。 我们的算法达到了 O(SA) 的最优空间复杂度，相比现有基于模型方法所需的 O(S^{2}A) 空间开销要高效得多。 与其他节省内存的算法相比，我们的算法在更贴近现实异步设定下运行。 此外，我们证明该算法能够可靠地利用 \widetilde{O}\left(\frac{1}{\mu_{\mathsf{min}}\varepsilon^{2}(1-\gamma)^{3}\max\{1-\gamma,\sigma\}}+\frac{t_{\mathsf{mix}}}{\mu_{\mathsf{min}}(1-\gamma)}\right) 个样本得到一个 \varepsilon-近似 Q 函数估计。 该界在附加一个 \tilde{O}\left(\frac{1}{1-\gamma}\right) 因子的意义下几乎达到极小极大最优，并显著优于现有面向 RMDP 的异步 Q-learning 算法的样本复杂度。 最后，我们将该算法及其分析扩展到同步设定，实现了 \widetilde{O}\left(\frac{SA}{\varepsilon^{2}(1-\gamma)^{3}\max\{1-\gamma,\sigma\}}\right) 的样本复杂度。 这些结果凸显了我们的无模型方法在求解 RMDP 方面的有效性与高效性。

paragraphs.en: Our work paves the way for numerous future research directions. One direction for future research is to develop model-free algorithms with minimax-optimal sample complexity for robust MDPs. For standard MDPs, Li et al. (2024a) establish that vanilla Q-learning incurs an additional factor of ( 1 − γ ) − 1 (1-\gamma)^{-1} relative to the minimax lower bound. This limitation does not rule out improvements through algorithmic modifications: variance reduction improves the effective-horizon dependence of asynchronous Q-learning to ( 1 − γ ) − 3 (1-\gamma)^{-3} , matching the minimax dependence on this parameter ( Li et al., 2021b ) . Our robust Q-learning upper bound contains the same additional factor. It is therefore of interest to investigate whether variance reduction can close this gap in the robust setting. Another direction is to explore alternative distance measures, such as χ 2 \chi^{2} -divergence. While we have established a model-free algorithm and its sample complexity for RMDPs under the TV distance, our approach relies heavily on the specific structure of the TV uncertainty set and can not be extended trivially to more general uncertainty sets. Extending our resampling construction and its guarantees to other uncertainty sets is left for future work.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的工作为诸多未来研究方向铺平了道路。 未来研究的一个方向是为鲁棒 MDP 开发具有极小极大最优样本复杂度的无模型算法。 对于标准 MDP，Li 等人 （2024a）证明了普通的 Q-learning 相对于极小极大下界会产生 ( 1 − γ ) − 1 (1-\gamma)^{-1} 的额外因子。 这一局限并不意味着无法通过算法改进来克服：方差缩减将异步 Q-learning 的有效视野依赖性改进到 ( 1 − γ ) − 3 (1-\gamma)^{-3}，与该参数的极小极大依赖性相匹配（Li et al., 2021b）。 我们的鲁棒 Q-learning 上界包含同样的额外因子。 因此，研究方差缩减能否在鲁棒设定下弥合这一差距是有意义的。 另一个方向是探索其他距离度量，例如 χ 2 \chi^{2} 散度。 虽然我们已经建立了 TV 距离下 RMDP 的无模型算法及其样本复杂度，但我们的方法严重依赖于 TV 不确定性集的特定结构，无法直接推广到更一般的不确定性集。 将我们的重采样构造及其保证扩展到其他不确定性集留待未来工作。
